summary.text: Elaine Beech is an independent candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 65, in the November 3, 2026 general election; she previously represented the district as a Democrat from 2009 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Elaine Beech was born on March 16, 1960, and earned a bachelor's degree from Auburn University in 1983.
Her professional experience includes owning a small business and serving on the Washington County Board of Education.
Beech assumed office in the Alabama House of Representatives in 2009 as a Democrat and left office in 2018, after losing the November 2018 general election to Brett Easterbrook.

At the start of the 2015 legislative session she served on the Health, Rules, and Ways and Means General Fund committees, and in the 2011-2012 session she served on the Education Policy, Health, and Technology and Research committees.
In 2026 she is running without a party label against Republican John Knapp in a race with no incumbent.
